scenarios.title: Draft a Civil Plaint under CPC Order VII Rule 1 (recovery of money)

parameters.facts: Defendant failed to repay INR 12,50,000 advanced as friendly loan on 2024-09-15; cause of action arose on 2025-09-15 when last reminder was ignored.
reliefSought: recovery of INR 12,50,000 with 12% interest p.a.
